purpose: Prospective development retest of two reused A-error rule instances; not retrospective identification of an unobserved A table

reference.reuse: Exact v8 package references, prompts, C schema, serializer, evaluate and two-path score; no new truth or prompt feedback
reference.independence_limit: Developer-authored frozen references, independent of these new replies; no external human review

selection.duplicate_case_resolution: v7 voucher failure and v8 case_345 refer to the same frozen rule instance; one case, not a third independent instance
selection.historical_context: Luna v8 A errors: case_417 static repeats 1,3 and case_345 dynamic repeat 1; v7 case_345 voucher failure. Existing v8 C was already table/proposal correct 5/5 for each case/model; retain as context, do not pool new samples or call this a new hold-out.

schedule.order: repeat 0..4 then case_417,case_345; each reply independent, no prior replies or error hints

frozen_configuration.messages_parameters: Use v8 messages_for/parameters byte-for-byte for C; plan metadata is not sent to the model

scoring.primary: Exact stage-table set equality and unchanged whole proposal score, reported per case/model over five assigned repetitions
scoring.paths: Unmodified evaluate -> score uses original semantic evaluator plus direct stage-table oracle. Disagreement preserves raw counterexample and stops dispatch globally.
scoring.failure_taxonomy: Reuse all v8 categories including wrong_affected_player, non-change and own-table inconsistency; static proposal error is not called a wrong dynamic witness
scoring.historical_replay: Re-score old v8 A and C for these two cases without editing files/scores; retain exact A error raw replies and the separate v7 case_345 failure
scoring.verified_scope: Only exact frozen-reference agreement of this specific output, never a deployment or strategy certificate
scoring.reporting: Report all three state counts separately over assigned total; never combine unverified and verified into a pass rate. Local-check coverage must carry both boundary denominators: real outputs 12 residual wrong tables /19 wrong tables among 240 B/C tables in 360 outputs; mutations 151/192 unflagged wrong tables in a separate derived control set.

interpretation.table_wrong: Evidence of an emitted interpretation/representation error in THIS C reply, not confirmation that an earlier A reply had the same hidden error
interpretation.table_correct_proposal_wrong: Output-level export evidence in THIS C reply; separate malformed interface from valid but incorrect semantic export
interpretation.both_correct: No reproduced C error; consistent with an elicitation/interface benefit but does not identify the old A latent cause
interpretation.statistics: Two purposively selected reused rules and five technical repeats; descriptive counts only, no significance claim or formal sample-size inference
interpretation.repair_next: Do not begin repair calls. Choose subsequent preregistered repair targets from retained observable failures and clearly retain unresolved A attribution.

resources_and_stop.cost: Record actual tokens/latency and inherited frozen price estimates separately; not an effectiveness gate
resources_and_stop.anomaly: Inherit existing per-call and total anomaly caps, above the planned 10-call token-cap envelope; no sample reduction to chase a cost threshold
resources_and_stop.stop: Stop affected model on provider exception/timeout/refusal/missing usage/model mismatch; retain assigned unexecuted trials and unknown-cost reservation. Oracle disagreement stops all further dispatch. Keep truncation/schema/semantic failures and continue scheduled trials. No retries or automatic resume.
resources_and_stop.before_generation: Commit preregistration first; then test implementation, freeze source/reference/schema/request hashes and commit lock before any generation; verify committed bytes before dispatch
